mapper.select: select m.id as memberId, m.nickname as nickname, m.avatar as avatar, ifnull(m.point, 0) as score from ums_member m where m.del_flag = 0 order by ifnull(m.point, 0) desc, m.create_time asc, m.id asc limit #{limit}

select m.id as memberId, m.nickname as nickname, m.avatar as avatar, ifnull(g.exp_value, 0) as score from member_growth g join ums_member m on m.id = g.member_id and m.del_flag = 0 order by g.exp_value desc, g.member_id asc limit #{limit}
mapper.sql: select member_id, sum(exp_value - revoked_exp) as s from member_exp_earned where exp_value > 0 and earned_at >= #{weekStart} and earned_at < #{weekEnd} group by member_id
mapper.select: select m.id as memberId, m.nickname as nickname, m.avatar as avatar, p.s as score from () p join ums_member m on m.id = p.member_id and m.del_flag = 0 order by p.s desc, m.create_time asc, m.id asc limit #{limit}

select (select count(*) from ums_member x where x.del_flag = 0 and (ifnull(x.point, 0) > base.s or (ifnull(x.point, 0) = base.s and (x.create_time < base.created or (x.create_time = base.created and x.id < base.memberId))))) + 1 as userRank, (select count(*) from ums_member where del_flag = 0) as totalUsers, base.s as score from ( select id as memberId, ifnull(point, 0) as s, create_time as created from ums_member where id = #{memberId} and del_flag = 0 ) base

select (select count(*) from member_growth x join ums_member active_member on active_member.id = x.member_id and active_member.del_flag = 0 where x.exp_value > base.s or (x.exp_value = base.s and x.member_id < base.memberId)) + 1 as userRank, (select count(*) from member_growth counted_growth join ums_member counted on counted.id = counted_growth.member_id and counted.del_flag = 0) as totalUsers, base.s as score from ( select member_id as memberId, exp_value as s from member_growth where member_id = #{memberId} ) base

select (select count(*) from () t join ums_member ranked on ranked.id = t.member_id and ranked.del_flag = 0 where t.s > base.s or (t.s = base.s and (ranked.create_time < base.created or (ranked.create_time = base.created and ranked.id < base.memberId)))) + 1 as userRank, (select count(*) from () c join ums_member counted on counted.id = c.member_id and counted.del_flag = 0) as totalUsers, base.s as score from ( select p.member_id as memberId, p.s, m.create_time as created from () p join ums_member m on m.id = p.member_id and m.del_flag = 0 where p.member_id = #{memberId} ) base
